notes: FDS native layout keeps bank 1 at $6000-$9FFF and bank 0 common at $A000-$DFFF in the boot PRG.
#pragma bank 2+ is automatically exported as non-boot PRG overlay files when --fds-auto-overlay is enabled.
Manual overlay/data files can still be added here with boot:false and source/path. Avoid ids used by auto overlays; default auto id for bank 2 is 32.
Phase30 adds FDS overlay farcall thunks, a resident-bank guard, and a generated overlay function table.
